{{Quote|Darth Charnus's ship, the Tears of Taris, is on Corellia now. A private shuttle outside the spaceport will take you there.|Sith Lord Feras directs Imperial heroes where to find Darth Charnus on Corellia|<ref name="CW" />}}
The '''''Tears of Taris''''' was a legendary [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]] in the service of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] for over three hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was part of [[Darth Malak|Darth Malak's]] [[Sith armada (Jedi Civil War)|fleet]] that [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombarded]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]] and participated in the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] later.

==History==
[[File:Tears_of_Taris_hangar.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A shuttle about to leave the hangar of the ''Tears of Taris''.]]
The ''Tears of Taris'' was originally a [[Centurion-class battlecruiser/Legends|''Centurion''-class battle cruiser]] from the era of the Jedi Civil War. It was part of [[Darth Malak]]'s fleet that [[Destruction of Taris|bombarded and devastated]] the planet [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. After the end of the Jedi Civil War and the fall of [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Malak's Sith Empire]], the ship changed hands many times over the centuries that followed, but it always served the Sith.<ref name="TORC" />

By the time of the [[Great Galactic War]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] named [[Darth Charnus]] became aware of the existence of the ''Tears of Taris''. Charnus ordered the ship to be disassembled and its key elements were integrated into a new [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]], as an act to honor the vessel that had survived for so long. The dreadnought was a formidable ship and it was designed to both besiege planets and deploy troops.<ref name="TORC" />

In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="3643BBY">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the empire and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the ''Tears of Taris'' opened fire on the Republic [[Warship/Legends|warship]] ''[[Enkindle]]'' which had entered Imperial space and ignored warnings to turn back, damaging it enough to force its withdrawal to [[Sarapin Four]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="SA" />

[[3640 BBY|Three years later]],<ref name="3640BBY">{{TOR_dates|4}}</ref> Darth Charnus brought the ''Tears of Taris'' into orbit over [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the Imperial [[Battle of Corellia|invasion]] of the planet during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="CW" />
